sample_unit: patients with suspected STEMI triggering emergent CCL activation

links.outcome: AI ECG versus standard triage sensitivity, specificity, and false positive activation rate against angiographic reference
links.effect: Sensitivity 92.0% vs 71.0%; specificity 81.0% vs 29.0%; FPA rate 7.9% vs 41.8% (P<0.001 for all); AUROC 0.94.
links.quote: The AI ECG model outperformed standard triage, demonstrating higher index ECG sensitivity (553 of 601 [92.0%; 95% CI: 89.7%-94.1%] vs 427 of 601 [71.0%; 95% CI: 67.4%-74.6%]), reducing FPA rates (34 of 431 [7.9%; 95% CI: 6.4%-9.6%] vs 180 of 431 [41.8%; 95% CI: 38.9%-44.7%]), and improving specificity (431 of 531 [81.0%; 95% CI: 77.2%-84.5%] vs 154 of 531 [29.0%; 95% CI: 24.8%-33.4%]) (P < 0.001 for all).

screen.reason: Retrospective multicenter validation study evaluating the diagnostic performance and simulated operational impact of an AI ECG model (Queen of Hearts) compared to standard clinical triage for STEMI/occlusion MI.
